title: Huge Aston Martin-McLaren LMGT3 crash deemed racing incident after stewards probe
extract: The Fuji 6 Hours collision between Aston Martin factory driver Mattia Drudi and McLaren driver Finn Gehrsitz was judged a racing incident, with neither driver held predominantly responsible.

title: Matthew Jeffreys challenges Gordon Murray's account of the McLaren MP4/4
extract: Former McLaren design engineer Matthew Jeffreys revisits the long-running dispute over who was responsible for the architecture and design of the legendary MP4/4.

title: Orange and Clutton overcome the odds to claim GT3 victory and title
extract: Simon Orange and Marcus Clutton overturned a sizeable points deficit to win the British GT3 championship, ending McLaren's long wait for a senior-class title.

title: NVIDIA launches Open Agent Safety Platform to secure AI agents
extract: NVIDIA has announced an open software platform and reference design intended to contain and secure autonomous AI agents from testing through deployment.

title: Nvidia launches new platform for reining in rogue AI agents
extract: NVIDIA's new Open Agent Safety Platform combines runtime safeguards and containment mechanisms aimed at reducing the risks posed by autonomous AI agents.

title: Truecaller takes its scam intelligence to the open web
extract: Truecaller has launched Scam Checker, allowing users to submit suspicious phone numbers, links or messages for checks against its scam-reporting and risk data.

title: Sennheiser Momentum 5 review: Great sound, incredible battery life, and few compromises
extract: The Momentum 5 headphones combine Dolby Atmos, expanded active noise cancellation, a user-replaceable battery and up to 57 hours of tested battery life.

title: Vette! arrives on the Amiga via Vesuri
extract: A fan project brings the 1991 Macintosh street racer Vette! to Amiga by executing its original 68000 code with a custom implementation of Macintosh system services.

title: Cat in the Sky with Diamonds is a new Amiga 500 game
extract: A new family-friendly Amiga 500 game made largely with AMOS Professional uses shifting gravity, obstacles and collectible diamonds in a colourful arcade-style design.

title: Lost in the Middle Ages is in development for the Amiga 500
extract: HooGames2017 has revealed a Scorpion Engine adventure for the Amiga 500, with five stages already built and a medieval world still being expanded.

title: POW is being converted to the Amiga as an AGA edition
extract: Developer ESKAY is converting SNK's arcade brawler P.O.W. for the Amiga 1200, using triple buffering, hardware scrolling and sprite-based HUD rendering.

title: Unseen photos of David Bowie at his peak
extract: A new extended-reality exhibition presents around 800 previously unseen photographs from David Bowie's 1983 Serious Moonlight tour, captured by photographer Denis O'Regan.

title: The Killers' Sam's Town turns 20 with its reputation rewritten
extract: The Killers' second album reaches its 20th anniversary, with a retrospective examining how its reception changed after its original release.

title: Omega highlights the enduring Constellation collection
extract: Omega's Japanese site marks the Constellation collection with a feature on its design history and enduring place in the brand's catalogue.

title: PW Studio: Publishing in China 2026: Phoenix Publishing and Media Group
extract: Publishers Weekly profiles Phoenix Publishing and Media Group, including its Yilin Sci-Fi imprint and its programme of Chinese and translated science fiction.

title: Transworld signs Mhairi McFarlane to two-book deal
extract: Transworld has acquired world rights to two forthcoming novels by Mhairi McFarlane, with Significant Others scheduled for spring 2028.

title: Jon Watts to direct the next Star Wars movie
extract: Jon Watts has been attached to direct a new Star Wars feature, with Simon Kinberg writing the screenplay.

title: Avengers: Endgame Encore scores $86 million globally
extract: Marvel's theatrical rerelease of Avengers: Endgame generated $86 million worldwide and includes new footage ahead of Avengers: Doomsday.

title: Margaret Qualley and Sabrina Carpenter join Fred Astaire biopic
extract: Margaret Qualley and Sabrina Carpenter have joined Tom Holland in Paul King's forthcoming Fred Astaire biopic, playing Adele Astaire and Ginger Rogers.

title: Lisa Henson takes viewers inside the Queensland Jim Henson exhibition
extract: Lisa Henson discusses the Brisbane exhibition celebrating 70 years of The Jim Henson Company and its puppetry and production history.
